scope_note: Server operations inventoried exhaustively from generated OpenAPI. Native static and directly returned template URL builders are extracted separately, with plugin/E2EE literal route calls. Arbitrary function-built URLs, lazy client code and external client services are not fully enumerated. Covered means explicit matching admin operation; partial and missing are conservative classifications requiring deeper route-by-route verification. Protected flows do not authorize impersonation or secret access.
